Subject: Pilot Proposal: Invoice Handling Assessment

Dear Morgan,

I’m writing to propose the approved six-week pilot to assess invoice handling, scoped exclusively to non-production environments to de-risk the engagement. At a fixed fee of $30,000, the pilot will test process efficiencies against the client’s 20% handling time target, acknowledging that no current baseline exists but that structured data collection during the window will enable future rollout decisions.

To proceed, security approval is required before any client data access. Once cleared, we can confirm a start date and activate the pilot.

I respectfully request your approval of the scope and fee, subject to security clearance, so we can advance to the next decision point and keep the project timeline on track.

Best regards,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead
